verses.text: A psalm by David. Praise the LORD, my rock! He trains my hands for war and gets my fingers ready for battle.
He's the one who loves me, my fortress, my lookout tower, my rescuer and my shield. He's where I run for safety, and he brings my people under my rule.
LORD, what are we humans that you'd care about us? Who are we that you'd even think of us?
We're like a breath. Our days slip by like a passing shadow.
Open up the heavens, LORD, and come down. Touch the mountains and watch them smoke.
Flash your lightning and scatter them. Fire your arrows and send them running.
Reach down from above and pull me out. Get me out of these deep waters, out of the hands of foreigners.
They lie through their teeth, and even the hand they raise to swear an oath can't be trusted.
God, I've got a new song for you. I'll play my ten-string lyre and sing your praises. 🎶
You're the one who saves kings. You pull your servant David clear of the sword that could kill him.
Get me out of the hands of foreigners. They lie through their teeth, and even the hand they raise to swear an oath can't be trusted.
Then our sons will stand like plants that have grown up strong, and our daughters like pillars carved to make a palace beautiful.
Our barns will be packed with supplies of every kind. Our sheep will multiply by the thousands and tens of thousands out in our fields.
Our oxen will haul heavy loads. No one will break in, no one will be driven away, and no cries of distress will ring through our streets.
Happy are the people who get to live like that! Happy are the people whose God is the LORD!
